name: VSCO Preset Look
summary: A quiet photo grade that copies film stock: matte blacks, soft contrast, muted greens and warm skin. A preset code such as A6 or HB2 sets it, and the app chrome stays pale and spare.

philosophy.core_thesis: A preset, not a filter: the edit imitates a real film stock and must look as if no edit happened.
design_principles: Lift the black point to 8% to 12% grey and cut contrast by 10% to 20%.
Pull saturation to 80% and shift greens toward teal (hue +10°) and skin toward warm beige.
Add a grain of 4% to 8% and keep it at 100% view only.
Name each preset with a short code of 2 to 3 characters, such as A6, and show it in 11px capitals.
Show the preset strip as flat tiles of 72px with a 1px outline, and show the strength slider from 0 to 12.
Keep the app chrome in off-white (#F2EFEA) and charcoal (#1F1E1C), with no colour except the photo.
Use a wide margin of 24px to 40px around each photo and leave no border on it.
anti_patterns: Many named filters with bold previews

layout.grid_mechanics: A grid of photos in 3 columns with 2px gaps, or a full-width single photo; the editor has a photo area and a 96px tool tray below it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 45% of the editor stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16, 24 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: The photo centres; tool labels align under their icons; text sits flush left at 24px.
layout.container_geometry: Photos with a 0px radius; tool tiles of 72px with a 2px radius and a 1px outline.

font_pairings.note: A geometric sans for names and a calm grotesque for text.
A thin, wide-set capital face for preset codes.
A modern sans pair for a clean app screen.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.04em; preset codes take +0.12em in capitals.
hierarchy_rules: Set preset codes in capitals at 11px.
Use one text colour on the page.

color.palette_structure: Warm off-white and charcoal chrome; photo tones of bone, taupe, faded teal and a warm highlight.
color.contrast_rules: Text on off-white holds at least 14:1; taupe and teal carry the slider, selected tile and links.
color.surface_treatment: Flat off-white and white fills; no gradient on chrome; the photo carries a matte grade with a lifted black point.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft, even light in photos; the chrome has no shadow beyond a 1px line of #DDD8CF.

materiality.surface_simulation: A contact sheet of film prints on matte paper.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px #DDD8CF outline on tiles and cards; no border on photos.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; a selected tile gets a 2px charcoal outline.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Fine outline icons at 24px with a 1.5px stroke: sliders, crop, grain and exposure.
ornamentation_details.illustration: No drawn art; only the photo and a small wordmark.

motion.transition_physics: A preset cross-fades over 200ms; the slider tracks the finger with no delay; tiles scroll with a soft stop of 300ms.
motion.hover_and_active: The selected tile shows a 2px outline; a long press compares the photo with the original and snaps back in 150ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm, relaxed and quietly stylish, with no sense of effort.

avoid_when: The brand needs bold, loud colour.
The photo must show exact product colour.
The page needs a strong graphic identity.

modifiers.how: Add the vignette, the cream print border and an amber fade.
Fix one preset for all photos and lay them in a strict 3-column grid.
Move to a dark ground, lower the exposure and add pink and sage tints.

pack.why: A thin, quiet line family that suits sliders and tool icons on a pale editor screen.

ground.why: The ground is soft, even light: a flat matte field with no pattern.
